name: nougen-ai
description: Warm editorial dark system in obsidian and gold. Earth-toned, weight-based depth, display type carrying the personality.

provenance.observed: Surfaces, ink, brand and accent colors, font family names, animation durations, breakpoints, and the gold focus outline, all measured from shipped CSS.
provenance.invented: Spacing, radii, type scale, weights, tracking, elevation, ink-on-fill tokens, and the text-safe copper and terracotta steps. The source declares none of these.

openWork: Neither named font is loaded. Syne and Inter appear in tokens but the application has no next/font import, no @font-face, and no stylesheet link, so both fall back to system UI and the display face does not exist at render time.
Dark-only by design. If a light context is ever needed it requires its own computed ramp; gold does not survive a light ground.
The scanline and shimmer keyframes are defined in the source but have no utility class bound to them.
